segments.verbatim_es: quando tu le diga que no hay ninguna agression como hai visto en la camara y todo eso..
segments.translation_en: When you tell him that there is no aggression, as you have seen on the camera and all that…

segments.verbatim_es: **Pero en si una agresion a una persona....no hay
segments.translation_en: But in itself, an aggression against a person… there is none.

segments.verbatim_es: Ya Leandro, ja voy dar el parte de la direcion general de aeronautica, lamentamos que tenga perdido tu vuelo, que esta decicion no la decidimos nosotros
segments.translation_en: Okay Leandro, I'm going to issue the report from the General Directorate of Civil Aviation; we regret that you lost your flight — this decision was not made by us.
